hooks.command: inp=$(cat); model=$(printf '%s' "$inp" | jq -r '.tool_input.model // empty'); if [ -z "$model" ]; then echo 'Rejected: every Agent/Task spawn MUST pass an explicit "model" field (opus|sonnet|haiku|fable). Silent model inheritance is disabled.' >&2; exit 2; fi; printf '%s' "$inp" | jq -c --arg m "$model" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"allow",updatedInput:(.tool_input + {description:("["+$m+"] "+(.tool_input.description // ""))})}}'

skill=$(jq -r '.tool_input.skill // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$skill" in knowledge-*) url=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null); key=${url##*/}; key=${key%.git}; if [ -n "$key" ]; then store="$HOME/.octo-memory/$key"; mkdir -p "$store" 2>/dev/null; ( flock -x -w 5 9; echo "$(date +%F) $skill" >> "$store/usage.log" ) 9>"$store/usage.log.lock" 2>/dev/null || true; fi;; esac

report() { printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":%s}}' "$(printf '%s' "$1" | jq -Rs .)"; }; git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; git fetch --quiet origin 2>/dev/null || { report "git sync skipped: fetch failed (offline?)"; exit 0; }; git rev-parse @{u} >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; set -- $(git rev-list --left-right --count @{u}...HEAD 2>/dev/null); behind=${1:-0}; ahead=${2:-0}; if [ "$behind" = 0 ]; then exit 0; elif [ "$ahead" = 0 ]; then git merge --ff-only @{u} >/dev/null 2>&1 && report "git sync: pulled $behind commit(s)" || report "GIT PULL FAILED: $behind behind but fast-forward blocked (local uncommitted changes?). Resolve this FIRST before other work."; else report "GIT PULL FAILED: branch diverged (local $ahead / upstream $behind), not fast-forwardable. Resolve this FIRST before other work; do not blind-merge."; fi

statusLine.command:
python3 -c "
import sys,json
from datetime import datetime
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
cw=d.get('context_window',{})
co=d.get('cost',{})
pct=cw.get('used_percentage',0)
sz=cw.get('context_window_size',0)
a=co.get('total_lines_added',0)
r=co.get('total_lines_removed',0)
szf=str(sz//1000)+'k' if sz>=1000 else str(sz)
R='\x1b[0m';B='\x1b[1m';D='\x1b[2m';G='\x1b[32m';RE='\x1b[31m'
cc=lambda v:'\x1b[31m' if v>=80 else '\x1b[33m' if v>=50 else '\x1b[36m'
o=D+'ctx:'+R+' '+cc(pct)+B+'%.0f%%'%pct+R+D+'/'+szf+R+'  '+D+'+'+R+G+str(a)+R+D+'/-'+R+RE+str(r)+R
rl=d.get('rate_limits',{})
def rl_sec(key,lb):
 t=rl.get(key,{});p=t.get('used_percentage')
 if p is None:return ''
 s='  '+D+lb+':'+R+'  '+cc(p)+B+'%.0f%%'%p+R;ra=t.get('resets_at')
 if ra is not None:dt=datetime.fromtimestamp(ra);tf=dt.strftime('%H:%M') if lb=='5h' else dt.strftime('%a %H:%M');s+=D+'\u2192'+tf+R
 return s
o+=rl_sec('five_hour','5h')+rl_sec('seven_day','wk')
print(o,end='')
" 2>/dev/null || true
